current_evidence_statement: In Mechanicsville, IA (2022), the current source-grounded record reports a 10% increase for full-time employees but expressly excludes the police officer; a separate record reports 3% for part-time library and ambulance employees. This supports a bounded local documentary contrast between an explicit police exclusion and non-safety growth terms. It does not establish a police growth rate, final wage-gap estimate, national pattern, population prevalence, or causal effect, and it requires final manual validation.
